Your holdings: SOXL (-51.98%) and SPAL (-44.89%) are both leveraged ETFs showing massive losses and need immediate attention. SPAL is a brand-new position with a significant drawdown. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH (-11.59%), CRWD (+5.82%), and QQQI (-4.18%) are also flagged for trimming.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Treasury yield movements and how they impact tech valuations. Also, monitor your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) for further decay or sharp moves.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your leveraged, losing positions while watching for confirmation of tech sector strength.
plays: Review SOXL and SPAL: Both leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and flagged for attention. Re-evaluate their stops and consider trimming to reduce margin exposure.
